reports.title: Aurinia Pharmaceuticals Reports Financial Results for the Three and Nine Months Ended

lines: Aurinia is increasing its total revenue guidance for 2026 from a range of $315 million to $325 million to a range of $325 million to $330 million.
Aurinia is narrowing its net product sales guidance for 2026 from a range of $305 million to $315 million to a range of $310 million to $315 million.

desk.headline: Revenue up 14% to $83.7m, EPS $0.23 beat estimate; 2026 revenue guidance raised to $325–330m
results: Sales of LUPKYNIS, its oral lupus nephritis drug, rose 12% to $79.4m; total revenue rose 14% to $83.7m.
Pre-tax profit rose 21% to $38.7m, but net income was flat at $31.7m because tax charges rose to $7.0m from $0.4m.
Research spending nearly doubled to $16.6m as aritinercept moved into clinical work in four possible uses.
Cash and investments reached $486.9m; in the first nine months it bought back 5.0m shares for $74.9m.
A new study (PRESERVE) will test LUPKYNIS combined with biologic drugs in about 150 patients.

guidance.summary: Full-year 2026 total revenue guidance was raised and the LUPKYNIS sales range was narrowed upward at the low end.

watch: Whether LUPKYNIS sales keep growing at double digits into Q4.
Rising research costs as aritinercept trials expand.
